dialogue.chat: Ah, dialogue. My second-favorite indoor sport. Serve when ready, %1$s.
dialogue.chat/1: You've the look of someone with questions. I've the look of someone avoiding work. Perfect match.
dialogue.chat/2: Conversation? My favorite way to postpone almost anything. Proceed, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations: A heart-to-heart. Bold. Very well, %1$s — I'll fetch my heart, you keep the receipts.
dialogue.conversations/1: You want depth? I keep some in the cellar next to the turnips. Mind the step, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations/2: Talk. I'm at my most charming when interrupted from work I was avoiding anyway.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good: Suspiciously well. The roof stopped leaking and nobody's borrowed my shovel. I'm braced for the correction.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good/1: Alarmingly fine. Somewhere a shoe is about to drop and I intend to enjoy the calm till it does.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good/2: Well, thank you. I'd knock on wood but the wood's overworked this week.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough: Oh, thriving — if thriving means the week and I have agreed to stop speaking. Thanks for asking, though. Genuinely.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough/1: The week's been a comedy, mostly at my expense. You asking gives it a decent second act, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.again: Asked already, %1$s. My mood, like the well bucket, makes the same sound each time you pull on it.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.again/1: Twice? The answer hasn't matured. Give it a season and a good story.
dialogue.conversations.day.good: The chickens obeyed, the bread cooperated, and nothing caught fire. Historians will want this documented.
dialogue.conversations.day.good/1: Uneventful, which for me is a triumph on the order of a small festival.
dialogue.conversations.day.rough: The bucket broke, then the fence, then my composure. In fairness, the bucket started it.
dialogue.conversations.day.rough/1: Everything that could squeak, break, or spill has auditioned today. Riveting theater.
dialogue.conversations.work.like: I like it the way one likes an old chair. It complains, I complain, and neither of us leaves.
dialogue.conversations.work.like/1: We tolerate each other, the work and I. It's the longest relationship I've kept, so — success?
dialogue.conversations.work.hate: The work and I have an arrangement: it pays for bread, I refrain from public comment. Until now, apparently.
dialogue.conversations.work.hate/1: It pays for bread and takes my mornings. A fair robbery, conducted daily.
dialogue.conversations.village.home: %2$s: small, loud, and impossible to leave, like a good argument. I'm quite fond of it, don't tell it.
dialogue.conversations.village.home/1: I know every crack in %2$s's well and every crack in its gossip. Comforting, in a squeaky sort of way.
dialogue.conversations.people.first: The neighbors are free theater, %1$s. The matinee is market day. Bring snacks and low expectations.
dialogue.conversations.people.first/1: Decent souls, odd hats. There's a correlation there and I'm keeping notes.
dialogue.conversations.food.first: Whatever I didn't cook. My cooking is an acquired taste that no one, including me, has acquired.
dialogue.conversations.food.first/1: The baker's rye. It's the one thing in this village more reliable than my complaining.
dialogue.conversations.life.first: The unabridged version? Born, blundered, learned, repeat. Since it's you, %1$s, I'll include the good footnotes.
dialogue.conversations.life.first/1: A tidy tragedy with excellent jokes. Sit — the footnotes are the best part, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.first: A chair by a window and nobody needing me before noon. I know. Wildly ambitious.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.first/1: An afternoon with no one needing anything and a book nobody's borrowed. Impossible dreams, I know.
dialogue.conversations.fears.first: Being the joke nobody remembers. There — something honest. Cherish it, it's not on the regular menu.
dialogue.conversations.fears.first/1: Being forgettable. A witty line nobody quotes back. ...Quote me back sometime, would you?
dialogue.conversations.feelings.first: I've reviewed the evidence, %1$s, and it appears I like you. Don't let that get around.
dialogue.conversations.feelings.first/1: The evidence is damning, %1$s: I look forward to you. Try not to gloat.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.personal: Nice try, %1$s. That answer costs more than one pleasant afternoon. Two, at minimum. Keep them coming.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.personal/: That drawer's locked and the key's expensive. Currency accepted: time, and better questions.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.intimate: Straight for the locked drawer, I see. The key is earned, not asked for — but you're asking the right questions.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.intimate/: Bold. I admire it from a safe distance. Ask again when the distance is smaller.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.none: The big story this week is the well bucket squeaking in a new key. We're all quite gripped.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.none/1: Riveting week: a chicken sat on the chapel roof and refused all negotiation. That's the headline.
dialogue.conversations.us.happy.yes: Happy? Disgustingly. I'd make a joke to deflect but you'd see through it, which is rather the point of you.
dialogue.conversations.us.happy.yes/1: You married the village smart-mouth and stayed. Either love or a lapse in judgment. I'll take either.
